status.summary: No. 15 UFC bantamweight, pro MMA record 19-3 (Sherdog, UFCalendar; ESPN and ufcrankings.org list 19-4). He moved down to bantamweight after the Jean Silva loss (UFC 314, Apr 12, 2025) and is 2-0 there: a decision over Said Nurmagomedov (Jul 26, 2025; 29-28 x3) and an arm-triangle submission of previously unbeaten Santiago Luna at 4:52 of round 3 at UFC Vegas 118 (Jun 6, 2026), with about eight seconds left. Luna was a late replacement for Victor Henry. He then lost a 15-minute featherweight grappling show match to UFC BJJ bantamweight champion Mikey Musumeci by unanimous decision, headlining UFC BJJ 11 (Sep 24, 2026, Meta APEX); it does not count on his MMA record. No MMA bout is booked as of Nov 6, 2026 (UFCalendar; ESPN lists only the Luna fight).

style.summary: A southpaw grappler who wins by taking opponents down and staying on top for most of the fight, then looking for arm-triangles, back takes and elbows. Standing he is careful and low-volume, kicking the legs and body from range to set up shots. When his takedowns fail against dangerous strikers he has been dropped or finished.

moves.notes: Southpaw: 'jab' is his right lead hand and 'cross' his left straight. Weights sum to about 1 within each target group; spinning/knee/elbow are separate propensities. fighters.json career split of significant attempts: 64% head, 26% body, 9% legs; landed 57/30/13. The decayed split (weighted toward recent fights) moves to 57/29/14 attempted and 46/33/21 landed, driven by the 21-of-21 leg-kick showing against Silva. Body work is a large share for a grappler, so body kick leads the body group and the straight left to the body is second. Most of his landed elbows are ground strikes (the Kron Gracie finish), which the director handles as ground elbows, so standing elbow stays low. No spinning techniques in his recorded UFC fights. The calf/inside split is a judgment (an open-stance southpaw kicking the orthodox lead leg mostly lands outside), not sourced. Sources: ufcstats sums and per-fight rows in data/raw.

engine_notes.note: Holds top control for 55% of his UFC fight time (career) and 61% (decayed); opponents control him 11-15%.
Takedown accuracy depends on the opponent: 7 of 13 vs Fili and 4 of 4 vs Barboza, but 1 of 14 vs Silva and 1 of 9 vs Topuria. Weight his takedown success by the opponent's takedown defence.
4 knockdowns absorbed in 13 UFC fights with only 1.51 significant strikes absorbed per minute: little incoming volume, but heavy damage per clean shot.
Landed rate in round 3 is 0.61 of round 1 (3-round fights), partly because late rounds turn into top control rather than strikes.
